name: seashard
description: SeaShard 模块化 Minecraft 服务器桌面管理器

scripts.build: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm run verify:service-catalog && vp build && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.preload.config.ts && vite build --config apps/plugin-host/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/database-worker/vite.config.ts && pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:cli
scripts.build:server: vite build --config apps/server/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/server-web/vite.config.ts && node scripts/stage-server-web.mjs
scripts.build:sdk: pnpm --filter @seashard/plugin-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @seashard/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @seashard/ui-sdk run build
scripts.package:host:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.host.yml --win nsis --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.host.yml --win nsis --publish never && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.check: pnpm run verify:service-catalog && vp check && vue-tsc --noEmit
